text:
Maya: Heads up - planning a tight PLG experiment for our mid-May launch posts + webinar tie-in. Idea: issue 40 credits to webinar attendees and to a sample of organic launch post engagers (Twitter/X + Linkedin). Compare activation from webinar vs social posts.

Liam: Nice. We'll need distinct UTM params: utm_source=webinar_midmay, utm_source=social_launchpost. Also tag event webinar_vs_social in analytics.

Priya: For routing, webinar leads -> webinar_followup sequence; social leads -> social_followup sequence. Both get the 40 credits but with different email timing (webinar +6h, social +12h).

Nina: I'll prepare 3 prompt packs tailored to each channel: Webinar pack (guided coach), Social pack (shortshare prompt + tweet optimization), and General dev pack. Each pack = 3 prompts.

Alex: Dynamic credits required. Backend piece small. We'll require one API call within 72h to mark credit redeemed. Also set 14-day expiry.

Maya: A/B subject lines for social follow-up: A = "Your 40 credits are ready"; B = "Try Redwood with 40 free credits (limited)". Send 60/40 to B.

Liam: Track metrics: credit_redemption_rate, first_gen_by_channel, 7-day_retention_by_channel. Schema in marketing/analytics/channel_compare.md.

Priya: Also let's add a small PR gift: attendees who redeem credits and generate >=3 responses get a follow-up invite to an office hours session. That could increase retention.

Maya: Good. Quick timeline: Nina templates (today), Alex backend + flag (48h), Priya routing + A/B (today), Liam analytics schema (today). Ready for launch May 12. :rocket:
